crossRefs.note: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may…
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you…
But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we…
For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me…
I will be yet more vile than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will…
But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.
For I say through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than…
So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong…
Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ…
and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much…
Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ…

translations.web: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
translations.bsb: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
translations.kjv: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
translations.asv: For whether we are beside ourselves, it is unto God; or whether we are of sober mind, it is unto you.
